Chhath mahaparv 2026 ko lekar rajdhani patna ke ganga ghaton par aastha ka adbhut najara dekhne ko mil raha hai. chhath vratiyon ki bhari bhir ghaton par umar pari hai. sir par daura, hathon men puja samagri aur chhathi maiya ke giton ke bich pura ganga tat bhaktimay mahaul men najar aa raha hai. dekhie patna ke ganga ghaton se chhath mahaparv ki ye khas tasviren.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
